page.overview:
Who is Giberson?

Giberson, known as "The Concealer", is a veteran warehouseman and one of the emperors of the Underworld.

Giberson is an older man whose back is slightly hunched. He has a big white mustache and wears a tall striped hat on his head; no hair can be seen on the top of his head. He wears a striped suit and pants.

Giberson appears to be a heavy drinker, as he has always been seen with a bottle in hand, and often acts jovially drunk.

Despite the Charlotte Family revealing their treacherous plot to destroy the Vinsmoke Family, Giberson insensitively found Vinsmoke Judge's crying and pleas to be amusing, and was not bothered by this act of betrayal (albeit not directed to him).
